SNOM M30 Cordless Black DECT IP Phone with Cradle

Enhance your office communication with the SNOM M30 Cordless Black DECT IP Phone with Cradle—a professional-grade, wireless VoIP handset designed for dynamic work environments in Bangladesh. Whether you're in an office, call center, or educational institution, the SNOM M30 offers crystal-clear HD audio, a 2-inch color LCD display, and long battery life to keep you connected throughout the day.

Its DECT 6.0 technology ensures secure and reliable wireless communication, while the included cradle provides convenient charging and docking. With Over-the-Air (OTA) software updates, the M30 ensures your device stays current with the latest features and security enhancements.

Key Technical Specifications

  • Model: SNOM M30
  • Display: 2.0" TFT color LCD, 176 x 220 pixels, backlit
  • Audio: HD wideband audio, full-duplex speakerphone
  • Battery: 3.7V, 1100mAh Li-ion; up to 22 hours talk time; up to 350 hours standby
  • Charging Time: Approximately 6 hours
  • Keypad: 28 hard keys including 12-key ITU telephone keypad, 5-way navigation key, 3 context-sensitive function keys, 4 programmable line/function keys, 4 dedicated audio keys
  • Wireless Standard: DECT 6.0
  • Compatibility: Works with SNOM M400, M700, and M900 DECT base stations
  • Security: Supports TLS encryption and SRTP for secure communication
  • Additional Features: Belt clip, Over-the-Air (OTA) software updates, Hearing Aid Compatibility (HAC)
  • Dimensions: 128 x 53 x 25 mm
  • Weight: 112g (including battery and belt clip)
